items.kw: A male bird flies thousands of kilometers for 15 years, only to be reunited with his partner.
items.desc: An elderly Croatian man saved a wounded white stork, Malena, who could no longer fly. A male stork, Ak, fell in love with her. Every year, he traveled 16,000 kilometers between South Africa and Europe to reunite with her for fifteen years. When Ak failed to return one spring, the old man wrote to Lebanon’s president. The touching story pushed the country to amend bird-protection laws overnight. Just as everyone lost hope, Ak came back, badly injured but alive.

cm.ko: 너무 솔직해서 어색 😂😂😂

cm.t: Everybody thinks that they want everybody to be 100% honest. Believe me, you don’t. The only person who believes this is never experienced 100% honesty on a sustained basis before.
cm.ko: 모든 사람은 다른 사람 모두가 100% 정직해지기를 바라고 있다고 생각합니다. 믿어보세요, 그렇지 않아요. 100%의 정직함을 지속적으로 경험한 적이 없는 사람이 이런 생각을 하는 것뿐입니다.

cm.t: FFS. I forgot this one. Harry Enfield... comedy genius.
cm.ko: 아, 잊고 있었네요. 해리 엔필드... 정말 뛰어난 코미디 배우입니다.

cm.t: i'd thank him for his honesty. truth isnt colours and flowers.
cm.ko: 저는 그의 솔직함에 감사할 것입니다. 진실은 색깔이나 꽃이 아닙니다.

cm.t: Whenever a used car sales man says,' Let me be honest"...there is a problem.
cm.ko: "솔직히 말씀드리면..."이라고 말하는 중고차 판매원이 있을 때, 무언가 문제가 있다는 것을 의미합니다.
